notablePrerequisites: You control eight or fewer lands.
description:
Activate Budoka Gardener by tapping it, putting Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Budoka Gardener as it is a land due to Ashaya.
Repeat.

uses.name: Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life
